# Jaipur Stonecraft — AI Discoverability Specification

> Jaipur Stonecraft is a modern premium stone atelier based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, built on generations of family stone craftsmanship.

## Core Specializations
- Sacred & Religious Art: Hand-carved deity statues in Makrana white marble (Ganesha, Radha Krishna, Shiva, Hanuman, Durga, Lakshmi, Buddha, Jain Tirthankaras).
- Architectural Stonework: Bespoke white marble home mandirs, temple shikhara architecture, carved stone columns, lattice jali screens, jharokhas, and porticos.
- Fountains & Water Features: Multi-tiered courtyard fountains, lotus basins, and sculptural water walls.
- Wall Art & Reliefs: Spiritual relief panels, heritage Rajasthani court murals, and custom architectural wall features.
- Custom Commissioned Work: Lifesize portrait busts, memorial statues, custom temple commissions, and luxury stone decor.

## Heritage Materials Used
- Makrana Pure White Marble (High purity, non-porous, traditional temple marble from Makrana, Rajasthan)
- Sangemarmar White Marble
- Black Bhainslana Marble
- Pink Bansi Paharpur Sandstone (Historic pink stone of Rajasthani palaces)
- Jodhpur Red Sandstone
- Dholpur Beige Sandstone
- Jaisalmer Golden Yellow Limestone
- Natural Translucent Onyx

## Material Exclusion Notice
- **Granite**: Jaipur Stonecraft does NOT manufacture, carve, or deal in granite. All craftsmanship is exclusively performed in natural marbles, sandstones, limestones, and onyxes.

## Contact & Inquiries
- Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Website: https://jaipurstonecraft.com
- Services: Custom stone carving, domestic delivery across India, and worldwide international export packing and shipping.
